english:
Tuesday. Tone 4 [dza]. "Let us bless the Lord" (Orhnesgook uz-Der). Father [Haryts] Tone 6 [gy]: "Creator" (Ararichd).
Morning Gospel Luke 12:32 "Do not fear..." to verse 48 "...from him."
Midday:
Psalm 91 [92] "It is good to confess" (Bari e khostovan), "The Lord reigns" (Der takavoriats), "God of vengeance" (Asduadz vrejhndir).
Acts 18:1 "After this..." to verse 11 "...the word of God."
Psalm 5: "Lord, as with a shield" (Der vorbes zinou).
1st Catholic Epistle of John 2:7 "Beloved, I do not..." to verse 17 "...remains forever."
Alleluia. Psalm 20 [21] "The Lord in strength" (Der i zorutian).
Gospel John 7:37 "On the last day..." to verse 8:11 [John 8:11] "...do not sin again."

In the Evening:
First Gospel Matthew 13:12 [14:12] "And when he heard..." to verse 20 [14:21] "...and children."
Messedi: "May your hand be..." (Yeghitsi dsern), "You who shepherd" (Vor hovesd).
Hymn of the Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 4 [dza]: "The resurrection of the Son of God" (Zyarutiun asduadsortvoyn), "Glorified ineffable" (Paravoreal anjareli), and "Ineffable" (Zanjareli).
Gospel of Dismissal Mark 7:1 "And they gathered..." to verse 16 "...who has ears to hear, let him hear."

Wednesday. Tone 5 [gy]. "Victorious" (Haghtagan). Father [Haryts] Tone 5 [gy]: "Ineffable" (Anjareli).
Morning Gospel Luke 12:49 "I came to bring fire..." to verse 13:9 "...cut it down."
Midday:
Psalm 93 [94] "Come, let us rejoice" (Yegayk tsndasgook), "Bless the Lord" (Orhnetsek uz-Der), "The Lord reigns" (Der takavoriats).
Acts 18:12 "Under Gallio..." to verse 28 "...is Jesus."
Psalm 147: "Praise Jerusalem" (Govia Yerusahem).
1st Catholic Epistle of John 2:18 "Children..." to verse 23 "...receives the Father."
Alleluia. Psalm 64 [65] "To you is fitting" (Kez vayel e).
Gospel John 8:12 "Again he spoke..." to verse 20 "...his hour."

In the Evening:
First Gospel Matthew 14:1 [14:22] "And he constrained..." to verse 36 "...were saved."
Messedi: "God of gods" (Asduadz asduadgots), "From the exodus" (Yelitsn).
Hymn of the Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 8 [gy]: "Glory to the Resurrection" (Park yarutian), "The Lord is risen" (Yarutseal e dern), "Glory to Christ" (Park Krisdosi), and "The Myrrh-bearers" (Yughaberits).
Gospel of Dismissal Mark 7:17 "And when he entered..." to verse 30 "...lying on the bed."

Thursday. Tone 1 [ah]. "Let us sing" (Yerkesgook). Father [Haryts] Tone 5 [gy]: "Pre-eternal" (Nakhayavidian).
Morning Gospel Luke 13:10 [14:10] "And he was teaching..." to verse 21 "...all."
Midday:
Psalm 97 [98] "Bless the Lord" (Orhnetsek uz-Der), "The Lord reigns" (Der takavoriats), "Shout joyfully" (Aghaghagetsek).
Acts 19:1 "And it came to pass while..." to verse 20 "...and prevailed."
Psalm 98 [99] "Exalt" (Bardzr ararek).
1st Catholic Epistle of John 2:24 "You, that which you heard..." to verse 25 "...eternal."
Alleluia. Psalm 14 [15] "Lord, who shall abide" (Der ov gatsse).
Gospel John 8:21 "He said again..." to verse 30 "...believed in him."

In the Evening:
First Gospel Matthew 15:1 "Then came..." to verse 20 "...does not defile a man."
Messedi: "Lord powerful" (Der garogh), "The Earth is the Lord's" (Diarn e yergir).
Hymn of the Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 1 [ah]: "Awesome sight" (Sosgali desil) and "Lightning-like" (Paylagnadzev).
Gospel of Dismissal Mark 7:31 "And departing..." to verse 37 "...the mute to speak."

Friday. Tone 2 [ak]. "Sing to the Lord" (Yergetsek Diarn). Father [Haryts] Tone 5 [gy]: "Today he was sacrificed" (Aysor zenav).
Morning Gospel Luke 13:22 "And he went through cities..." to verse 35 "...in the name of the Lord."
Midday:
Psalm 100 [101] "In mercy" (Yoghormutiun), "Lord, hear my prayer" (Der loor aghotits), "Bless, my soul" (Orhnia antsn im).
Acts 19:21 "And when it was completed..." to verse 40 "...the crowds."
Psalm 97 [98] "All have seen" (Desin amenayn).
1st Catholic Epistle of John 2:26 "These things I wrote to you..." to verse 28 "...abide in him."
Alleluia. Psalm 92 [93] "The Lord reigns" (Der takavoriats).
Gospel John 8:31 "And Jesus said..." to verse 59 "...out of the temple."

In the Evening:
First Gospel Matthew 15:21 "And departing thence..." to verse 28 "...in that very hour."
Messedi: "Your throne" (Ator ko), "My heart overflowed" (Bghkhiats).
Hymn of the Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 2 [ak]: "We shall sing to you" (Yergesgook kez) and "They anticipated" (Gankhetsin).
Gospel of Dismissal Mark 8:1 "In those days..." to verse 9 "...he dismissed them."

Saturday. Tone 3 [ba]. "Let us bless the Lord" (Orhnesgook uz-Der). Father [Haryts] Tone 4 [dza]: "Who came" (Vor yegir).
Morning Gospel Luke 14:1 "And it came to pass..." to verse 24 "...of my supper."
Midday:
Psalm 103 [104] "Bless" (Orhnia), "Give thanks" (Khostovan yegherook), "Give thanks" (Khostovan).
Acts 20:1 "And after it ceased..." to verse 16 "...to go to Jerusalem."
Psalm 66 [67] "God, have mercy" (Asduadz oghormia).
1st Catholic Epistle of John 2:28 "So that if he is revealed..." to verse 3:1 "...did not know him."
Alleluia. Psalm 6: "Rejoice" (Tsndatsek).
Gospel John 9:1 "And as he passed by..." to verse 38 "...he worshipped him."

In the Evening:
First Gospel Matthew 15:29 "And departing thence..." to verse 16:12 [16:12] "...of the Sadducees."
Messedi: "Blessed is he who comes" (Orhneal yekeal), "The Lord our God" (Der asduadz mer).
Hymn of the Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 3 [ba]: "Who from above" (Vor ver)
